# IEEE Journals: Open-Access Model, APC 2026 and Time to First Decision

**Every main IEEE transactions, journal and letters title — 174 journals plus 43 magazines — grouped by research track**, with its publishing model (hybrid or fully open access), the 2026 article processing charge (APC), the price after the society-member discount, and the average time to first decision where one has been published.

🌐 [Searchable website](https://aionndc22.github.io/ieee-conference-deadlines/journals/) &nbsp;·&nbsp; 📥 [Excel](docs/IEEE_Journals_APC.xlsx) · [CSV](docs/journals.csv) · [JSON](docs/journals.json) · [YAML](data/journals.yml) &nbsp;·&nbsp; ✍️ [Add or fix a journal](CONTRIBUTING.md#journals) &nbsp;·&nbsp; 📅 [Conference deadlines](README.md)

> Prices are IEEE's 2026 list prices, last checked **2026-10-16**. Only **15 of 174** journals have a published time to first decision — help fill in the rest!

## How IEEE charges in 2026

| Model | APC | Society member (20% off) | If you don't choose open access | What it means |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Hybrid** | $2,800 | $2,240 | Free (overlength page charges may apply) | Subscription journal. Publishing is free unless you choose open access; mandatory overlength page charges may apply. |
| **Fully open access** | $2,160 | $1,728 | Not available — OA only | Gold open access: every accepted article pays the APC. Standard rate for most fully OA titles; a few titles differ. |
| **Hybrid magazine** | $2,995 | $2,396 | Free (most articles are invited) | Magazine with an optional open-access fee (most magazines). |

- **Discounts:** 5% for IEEE members or 20% for members of the journal's sponsoring society (they don't stack; students excluded). Authors from low- and lower-middle-income countries get reduced fees, and a full waiver in fully open-access journals when every author is from a low-income country.
- **Overlength pages:** many hybrid transactions charge per page beyond a limit (e.g. TGRS: US$230/page over 10 pages).
- **Exceptions:** a few titles have their own prices. Check IEEE's official per-journal APC list before budgeting.
- **Decision times** come from IEEE society pages (Official), named third-party guides (Third-party) or author reports (Crowd-sourced). Treat the last two as rough.

Know a journal's current APC, its open-access model, or its official time to first decision? Edit [`data/journals.yml`](https://github.com/aionndc22/ieee-conference-deadlines/edit/main/data/journals.yml) or [open an issue](https://github.com/aionndc22/ieee-conference-deadlines/issues/new/choose) with a source link. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#journals).
